verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is developer documentation for building an AI agent add-on with ADK and Vertex AI Agent Engine. That implies AI-driven assistance inside Drive is possible, but only if you build and deploy a custom agent yourself; there is no native insight or suggestion feature. OCR-based search of scanned documents is indexing, not AI-generated insight. Missing for 10: any native in-product AI insights or suggestions over user files, documentation of what such an add-on can surface from Drive data, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
